coding-medium.json.routing_reason: Default useful-work route when no stronger or cheaper rule applies. Tightly coupled work should stay with one agent or a deterministic workflow. Default to no reviewer for low-risk direct work.
coding-medium.json.fallback: Escalate to strong if verification fails, requirements conflict, or task risk increases.

complex-planning-delegated.json.routing_reason: High-complexity planning usually requires architecture-level judgment. High-complexity parallel work can benefit from specialized sub-agents. Delegated work needs synthesis and review.
complex-planning-delegated.json.fallback: Escalate to strong if verification fails, requirements conflict, or task risk increases.

debugging-medium.json.routing_reason: Medium or high complexity debugging needs deeper reasoning and careful verification. Tightly coupled work should stay with one agent or a deterministic workflow. Default to no reviewer for low-risk direct work.
debugging-medium.json.fallback: Escalate to strong if verification fails, requirements conflict, or task risk increases.

high-risk-review.json.routing_reason: High-risk tasks require the strongest model class. Tightly coupled work should stay with one agent or a deterministic workflow. High-risk tasks need independent verification.
high-risk-review.json.fallback: Escalate to strong if verification fails, requirements conflict, or task risk increases.

simple-writing.json.routing_reason: Simple, low-risk, low-tool tasks should use the cheapest capable model class. Simple tasks usually cost more to coordinate than to solve directly. Default to no reviewer for low-risk direct work.
simple-writing.json.fallback: Escalate to strong if verification fails, requirements conflict, or task risk increases.
